name: Gou
source:
Souya’s father and the village’s head.
His beastly strength and imposing presence are entirely unmatched within the village.
Gou is headstrong and stubborn, and yet he’s strangely weak in front of Rui’s requests.
He seems to harbor strong feelings for his son’s wife.
